specs.claim: An equal-risk-contribution portfolio on SPY/TLT/IEF/GLD/DBC, levered ex ante to the trailing volatility of a 60/40 SPY/AGG reference, clamped between 0.5x and 2.0x, and financed at the point-in-time 3-month T-bill plus 50 bps, clears the 60/40 on risk-adjusted return net of financing.
specs.signal: ret = adjusted_close.pct_change(); cov = ret.rolling(252).cov(); w_erc = long-only weights solving w_i * (cov @ w)_i equal across the five sleeves (each contributes 1/5 of portfolio variance), sum(w) = 1; book_vol = sqrt(w_erc' @ cov @ w_erc); ref = 0.60 * ret_SPY + 0.40 * ret_AGG (60/40 rebalanced monthly); ref_vol = ref.rolling(252).std() * sqrt(252); gross = clip(ref_vol / book_vol, 0.5, 2.0), reset once per year at the January anchor while w_erc re-estimates at each quarterly rebalance, all from data available on the rebalance date; final weights = gross * w_erc; decision uses data through bar t-1 (lag_bars 1).
specs.entry: always invested; weights reset to gross * w_erc at each quarterly rebalance
specs.exit: never flat; only weight drift between rebalances

specs.claim: Sequencing a ranked 252-day sector-ETF momentum book across three calendar windows each month - momentum on D-10..D-5, momentum on D+1, and the flipped (reversed) position on D+2..D+3 - earns about 6% annualized at a 0.55 Sharpe as a self-financing long-short sector portfolio invested under half the days.

specs.entry: After the close of D-10, enter long top-3 / short bottom-3 sector ETFs (equal dollar per name) on the prior month-end ranking; after the close of the last trading day of the month, enter the freshly ranked long top-3 / short bottom-3 book; after the close of D+1, flip to long bottom-3 / short top-3
specs.exit: Exit the pre-month-end leg at the close of D-5; exit-and-reverse the month-start leg at the close of D+1; close all positions at the close of D+3 and stay flat until the next D-10
